fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and humor columns (including recurring items about “Little Geraldine”), coverage of Hialeah civic recovery and local government, and extensive discussion of Miami’s entertainment and sporting scene (horse racing, dog racing, jai alai, golf). Contains editorials and notes touching on prohibition enforcement and politics, along with substantial advertising for Miami Beach nightlife venues, theaters, travel/tours, and local businesses and services.
